items.informal_name: Weighted Sum Evaluation: $ \text{weight } w f = \sum_{i \in \text{support } f} c_i \cdot w(i) $
items.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {M : Type u_2} {R : Type u_3} [inst : Semiring R] (w : σ → M) [inst_1 : AddCommMonoid M]
  [inst_2 : Module R M] (f : σ →₀ R), (Finsupp.weight w) f = f.sum fun i c => c • w i
items.informal_description: For any finite support function $ f : \sigma \to_0 R $, the weight function applied to $ f $ is equal to the sum over all $ i $ in the support of $ f $ of $ c \cdot w(i) $, where $ c $ is the coefficient of $ i $ in $ f $ and $ w : \sigma \to M $ is a function assigning vectors to indices.

items.informal_name: Weighted sum of vectors indexed by σ over R
items.type:
{σ : Type u_1} →
  {M : Type u_2} →
    {R : Type u_3} → [inst : Semiring R] → (σ → M) → [inst_1 : AddCommMonoid M] → [Module R M] → (σ →₀ R) →+ M
items.informal_description: The additive homomorphism from the space of finite support functions $ \sigma \to_0 R $ to the module $ M $, which maps each finite support function $ d $ to the sum $ \sum_{i \in \text{support } d} d(i) \cdot v_i $, where $ v_i $ denotes the vector associated with index $ i $.

items.informal_name: Weight Homomorphism on Single Finite Support Function
items.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {M : Type u_2} {R : Type u_3} [inst : Semiring R] (w : σ → M) [inst_1 : AddCommMonoid M]
  [inst_2 : Module R M] (s : σ) (r : R), (Finsupp.weight w) (Finsupp.single s r) = r • w s
items.informal_description: For any index $ s $ and scalar $ r $, the weighted sum homomorphism $ \text{weight}_w $ applied to the finite support function that assigns $ r $ to $ s $ and zero to all other indices equals $ r \cdot w(s) $.

items.informal_name: Linear combination of vectors indexed by α over R
items.type:
{α : Type u_1} →
  {M : Type u_2} →
    (R : Type u_5) →
      [inst : Semiring R] → [inst_1 : AddCommMonoid M] → [inst_2 : Module R M] → (α → M) → (α →₀ R) →ₗ[R] M
items.informal_description: The linear map from the space of finite support functions $ \alpha \to_0 R $ to the module $ M $, which sends each finite support function $ d $ to the sum $ \sum_{i \in \text{support } d} d(i) \cdot v_i $, where $ v_i $ denotes the vector associated with index $ i $. This map is constructed using the linear equivalence of summing scalar multiples of individual vectors embedded via the right scalar multiplication operation.

items.informal_name: Linear Combination of Vectors Indexed by α over R
items.type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} {M : Type u_2} (R : Type u_5) [inst : Semiring R] [inst_1 : AddCommMonoid M] [inst_2 : Module R M]
  {v : α → M} (l : α →₀ R), (Finsupp.linearCombination R v) l = l.sum fun i a => a • v i
items.informal_description: The linear map from the space of finite support functions $ \alpha \to_0 R $ to the module $ M $, which sends each finite support function $ l $ to the sum $ \sum_{i \in \text{support } l} l(i) \cdot v_i $, where $ v_i $ denotes the vector associated with index $ i $. This map is constructed using the linear equivalence of summing scalar multiples of individual vectors embedded via the right scalar multiplication operation.
